name: word-winforms-addin
description: Microsoft Word Taskpane Add-in với phong cách UI/UX WinForms Classic

scripts.start: office-addin-debugging start manifest.xml desktop --app word --dev-server "node server.js" --dev-server-port 3000 --no-debug
scripts.clear-cache: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Name WINWORD -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path ($env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Wef\*') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Đã xóa sạch Office cache!'"

author: Antigravity
